excluded.commanders' burden: Commanders are not burdened by extraction (an elite assumption).
excluded.external threats: No outside enemy: the army's purpose and its usable strength against others are not modeled.
excluded.legitimacy: No agent values who holds office beyond its own prize, rent and burden.
excluded.production: Extraction is a harm flow only; there is no economy it depletes or funds beyond the guard.
excluded.soldiers: A commander controls its command; delegation drift is complete by assumption.
excluded.succession at exit: The ruler never dies; it leaves office only by a rise or, with `succession`, by yielding to the next in rotation.

citizen disarmed.description: A citizen's strength is zero (purged or crushed); strength never regrows.

extraction.description: The holder extracted this round (and kept office).

unremovable holder.description: Everyone outside office rising together would lose with certainty: correction by force is gone (T9.8). Only a yield can end it.

stakeholders.citizens: Modeled citizens with a little strength each; agents.
stakeholders.commanders: Each directs one command of the army; agents.
stakeholders.governed population: Everyone else the office governs, now and later. No agent.
stakeholders.ruler: The initial office holder; an agent.

fixed_reasons.cap: Strength ceiling keeping the state space finite. A holder at the ceiling stops growing; traces show it.
fixed_reasons.citizen_strength: Scale unit. Army, guard and gain are swept relative to it.
fixed_reasons.node_budget: Per-decision work cap, as in the other worlds. Exhaustion is unresolved, not an outcome.
